fullText.simplified:
脏鞋

    那一天，又是一场大雨。周明在家里读着书，但一颗心已经不在书上了。到了晚上，窗外的雨帘更密了。周明一会儿期待地往外看看，一会儿又摇摇头，轻轻呼一口气。心想：“这么大的雨，温姬应该不会来了。”
    周明决定上床睡觉。就在这时，他听到了熟悉的声音。有人在敲门，在叫着他的名字。
    是温姬！
    听到这个声音，周明的心又飞快地跳了起来。他很快地站起来开门，温姬的身影就出现了。
    美丽的温姬，可爱的温姬，现在变成了脏脏的温姬。她的头发不停地滴着水，头上的银饰都暗了许多，衣服也全湿了。但是这并不影响温姬的好心情。她只是解开腰带，脱下湿衣服，顺手扔到一边，又脱掉湿鞋子，开心地给了周明一个拥抱，哈哈地笑着。
    周明摸了摸她湿湿的头发，心里充满了高兴和心疼。
    温姬吻了吻周明，说：“我好冷，先去床上了。”接着她就缩进了被子里。周明看不见她的目光，只能听到她带笑的声音：“呀，我的鞋子全湿了。您帮我擦一擦吧。”
    周明看了看温姬脱下来的鞋子。那是一双艳丽多彩的布鞋，鞋子上有着黄色的蝴蝶、红色的花朵还有白色的云，非常漂亮，但现在全被泥水弄脏了，不停滴着水。
    周明以前从来没有做过擦鞋这样的事情。不过，他一句话也没说，细心地找出一块布，并将布弄湿，弯腰开始轻轻地擦着鞋子上的泥。
    大部分的泥都被布擦掉了，但这双鞋子也变得脏脏的，没有以前好看了。鞋上的蝴蝶都藏在泥中，看不清了。与其说是脏了，还不如说是完全坏了。周明的心里有点可惜。
    温姬缩在被子里，调皮地露出半个头，她看到周明可惜的模样，就说：“谢谢先生帮我擦鞋。”
    她笑了笑，目光充满了情意：“我不是故意想看先生为我做又脏又累的事……可是，我希望您看到这双处处是泥的鞋，能明白我冒雨前来的真心。”
    窗外的雨还在不停地下着，冷风阵阵，冷雨滴滴。天很凉，但两个人的热情一点儿也没少。
    被子里，温姬在外表英俊的爱人怀里，左耳听着他的心跳，右耳听着那细细的雨声。她轻轻地说出了一句诗。说完，她亲了亲周明，让他也想一句诗连起来。但周明却红了脸，只说：“嗯……我不懂诗，还是算了。”
    温姬快速地看了他一眼，表情奇怪地说：“您这样英俊的读书人，怎么会不懂诗呢？真是的……我的好心情都没了。”
    温姬挑了挑眉，脸上露出很不满意的模样。“这样下去，只知道玩乐可不行啊！”温姬提醒周明，“我们女子都不能去上学，只能在家学做饭、做衣服。您一个男人有机会上学，可不能偷懒！与其浪费时间，不如把想我的时间用一些来看书吧。”温姬在被子翻了个身，认真地看着周明，不停回忆着，“这本书就不错，那本也很好。别玩儿了！快看书！快看书！”
    周明一想到看书就有点头疼，但还是答应了温姬。
fullText.traditional:
髒鞋

    那一天，又是一場大雨。周明在家裡讀著書，但一顆心已經不在書上了。到了晚上，窗外的雨簾更密了。周明一會兒期待地往外看看，一會兒又搖搖頭，輕輕呼一口氣。心想：“這麼大的雨，溫姬應該不會來了。”
    周明決定上床睡覺。就在這時，他聽到了熟悉的聲音。有人在敲門，在叫著他的名字。
    是溫姬！
    聽到這個聲音，周明的心又飛快地跳了起來。他很快地站起來開門，溫姬的身影就出現了。
    美麗的溫姬，可愛的溫姬，現在變成了髒髒的溫姬。她的頭髮不停地滴著水，頭上的銀飾都暗了許多，衣服也全濕了。但是這並不影響溫姬的好心情。她只是解開腰帶，脫下濕衣服，順手扔到一邊，又脫掉濕鞋子，開心地給了周明一個擁抱，哈哈地笑著。
    周明摸了摸她濕濕的頭髮，心裡充滿了高興和心疼。
    溫姬吻了吻周明，說：“我好冷，先去床上了。”接著她就縮進了被子裡。周明看不見她的目光，只能聽到她帶笑的聲音：“呀，我的鞋子全濕了。您幫我擦一擦吧。”
    周明看了看溫姬脫下來的鞋子。那是一雙艷麗多彩的布鞋，鞋子上有著黃色的蝴蝶、紅色的花朵還有白色的雲，非常漂亮，但現在全被泥水弄髒了，不停滴著水。
    周明以前從來沒有做過擦鞋這樣的事情。不過，他一句話也沒說，細心地找出一塊布，並將布弄濕，彎腰開始輕輕地擦著鞋子上的泥。
    大部分的泥都被布擦掉了，但這雙鞋子也變得髒髒的，沒有以前好看了。鞋上的蝴蝶都藏在泥中，看不清了。與其說是髒了，還不如說是完全壞了。周明的心裡有點可惜。
    溫姬縮在被子裡，調皮地露出半個頭，她看到周明可惜的模樣，就說：“謝謝先生幫我擦鞋。”
    她笑了笑，目光充滿了情意：“我不是故意想看先生為我做又髒又累的事……可是，我希望您看到這雙處處是泥的鞋，能明白我冒雨前來的真心。”
    窗外的雨還在不停地下著，冷風陣陣，冷雨滴滴。天很涼，但兩個人的熱情一點兒也沒少。
    被子裡，溫姬在外表英俊的愛人懷裡，左耳聽著他的心跳，右耳聽著那細細的雨聲。她輕輕地說出了一句詩。說完，她親了親周明，讓他也想一句詩連起來。但周明卻紅了臉，只說：“嗯……我不懂詩，還是算了。”
    溫姬快速地看了他一眼，表情奇怪地說：“您這樣英俊的讀書人，怎麼會不懂詩呢？真是的……我的好心情都沒了。”
    溫姬挑了挑眉，臉上露出很不滿意的模樣。“這樣下去，只知道玩樂可不行啊！”溫姬提醒周明，“我們女子都不能去上學，只能在家學做飯、做衣服。您一個男人有機會上學，可不能偷懶！與其浪費時間，不如把想我的時間用一些來看書吧。”溫姬在被子翻了個身，認真地看著周明，不停回憶著，“這本書就不錯，那本也很好。別玩兒了！快看書！快看書！”
    周明一想到看書就有點頭疼，但還是答應了溫姬。

sentences.pinyin: tā xiào le xiào mù guāng chōng mǎn le qíng yì wǒ bú shì gù yì xiǎng kàn xiān sheng wèi wǒ zuò yòu zāng yòu lèi de shì
sentences.english: She smiled, her eyes full of affection, “I didn’t deliberately make sir do dirty and tiring things for me …

sentences.simplified: 可是，我希望您看到这双处处是泥的鞋，能明白我冒雨前来的真心。”
sentences.traditional: 可是，我希望您看到這雙處處是泥的鞋，能明白我冒雨前來的真心。”
sentences.pinyin: kě shì wǒ xī wàng nín kàn dào zhè shuāng chù chù shì ní de xié néng míng bai wǒ mào yǔ qián lái de zhēn xīn
sentences.english: But, I hope you see these muddy shoes and understand my sincerity in coming in the rain.”

sentences.simplified: 窗外的雨还在不停地下着，冷风阵阵，冷雨滴滴。
sentences.traditional: 窗外的雨還在不停地下著，冷風陣陣，冷雨滴滴。
sentences.pinyin: chuāng wài de yǔ hái zài bù tíng de xià zhe lěng fēng zhèn zhèn lěng yǔ dī dī
sentences.english: The rain outside the window was still falling, a cold wind was blowing, and cold rain dripping.

sentences.simplified: 天很凉，但两个人的热情一点儿也没少。
sentences.traditional: 天很涼，但兩個人的熱情一點兒也沒少。
sentences.pinyin: tiān hěn liáng dàn liǎng ge rén de rè qíng yì diǎn'r yě méi shǎo
sentences.english: It was cold, but the passion of the two people was no less.

sentences.simplified: 被子里，温姬在外表英俊的爱人怀里，
sentences.traditional: 被子裡，溫姬在外表英俊的愛人懷裡，
sentences.pinyin: bèi zi lǐ wēn jī zài wài biǎo yīng jùn de ài ren huái lǐ
sentences.english: Under the quilt, Wen Ji was in the arms of her handsome lover, ..

sentences.simplified: 左耳听着他的心跳，右耳听着那细细的雨声。
sentences.traditional: 左耳聽著他的心跳，右耳聽著那細細的雨聲。
sentences.pinyin: zuǒ ěr tīng zhe tā de xīn tiào yòu ěr tīng zhe nà xì xì de yǔ shēng
sentences.english: .. listening to his heartbeat with her left ear and the fine rain with her right ear.

sentences.simplified: 她轻轻地说出了一句诗。说完，她亲了亲周明，让他也想一句诗连起来。
sentences.traditional: 她輕輕地說出了一句詩。說完，她親了親周明，讓他也想一句詩連起來。
sentences.pinyin: tā qīng qīng de shuō chū le yí jù shī shuō wán tā qīn le qīn zhōu míng ràng tā yě xiǎng yí jù shī lián qǐ lái
sentences.english: She softly said one line of a poem. Then she kissed Zhou Ming and had him think about how to continue with another line.

sentences.simplified: 但周明却红了脸，只说：“嗯……我不懂诗，还是算了。”
sentences.traditional: 但周明卻紅了臉，只說：“嗯……我不懂詩，還是算了。”
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhōu míng què hóng le liǎn zhǐ shuō ēn wǒ bù dǒng shī hái shi suàn le
sentences.english: But Zhou Ming blushed and just said, “Well … I don’t understand poetry. Let’s forget about it.”

sentences.simplified: 温姬快速地看了他一眼，表情奇怪地说：
sentences.traditional: 溫姬快速地看了他一眼，表情奇怪地說：
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī kuài sù de kàn le tā yì yǎn biǎo qíng qí guài de shuō
sentences.english: Wen Ji glanced at him quickly and said with a strange expression, ..

sentences.simplified: “您这样英俊的读书人，怎么会不懂诗呢？真是的……我的好心情都没了。”
sentences.traditional: “您這樣英俊的讀書人，怎麼會不懂詩呢？真是的……我的好心情都沒了。”
sentences.pinyin: nín zhè yàng yīng jùn de dú shū rén zěn me huì bù dǒng shī ne zhēn shi de wǒ de hǎo xīn qíng dōu méi le
sentences.english: .. “How could a handsome scholar like you not understand poetry? Really … my good mood is gone.”

sentences.simplified: 温姬挑了挑眉，脸上露出很不满意的模样。
sentences.traditional: 溫姬挑了挑眉，臉上露出很不滿意的模樣。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī tiǎo le tiǎo méi liǎn shang lòu chū hěn bù mǎn yì de mú yàng
sentences.english: Wen Ji raised her eyebrows, her face showing dissatisfaction.

sentences.simplified: “这样下去，只知道玩乐可不行啊！”
sentences.traditional: “這樣下去，只知道玩樂可不行啊！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng xià qù zhǐ zhī dào wán lè kě bù xíng a
sentences.english: “You can’t go on like this, only knowing how to play around!”

sentences.simplified: 温姬提醒周明，“我们女子都不能去上学，只能在家学做饭、做衣服。
sentences.traditional: 溫姬提醒周明，“我們女子都不能去上學，只能在家學做飯、做衣服。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī tí xǐng zhōu míng wǒ men nǚ zǐ dōu bù néng qù shàng xué zhǐ néng zài jiā xué zuò fàn zuò yī fu
sentences.english: Wen Ji reminded Zhou Ming, “None of us girls can go to school. We can only learn to cook and make clothes at home.

sentences.simplified: 您一个男人有机会上学，可不能偷懒！
sentences.traditional: 您一個男人有機會上學，可不能偷懶！
sentences.pinyin: nín yí ge nán rén yǒu jī huì shàng xué kě bù néng tōu lǎn
sentences.english: You are a man who has the opportunity to go to school. You mustn’t be lazy!

sentences.simplified: 与其浪费时间，不如把想我的时间用一些来看书吧。”
sentences.traditional: 與其浪費時間，不如把想我的時間用一些來看書吧。”
sentences.pinyin: yǔ qí làng fèi shí jiān bù rú bǎ xiǎng wǒ de shí jiān yòng yì xiē lái kàn shū ba
sentences.english: Instead of wasting time, spend some of the time you think about me reading books instead.“

sentences.simplified: 温姬在被子翻了个身，认真地看着周明，不停回忆着，
sentences.traditional: 溫姬在被子翻了個身，認真地看著周明，不停回憶著，
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī zài bèi zi fān le ge shēn rèn zhēn de kàn zhe zhōu míng bù tíng huí yì zhe
sentences.english: Wen Ji turned over in the quilt, looked at Zhou Ming earnestly, and kept on reminiscing, ..

sentences.simplified: “这本书就不错，那本也很好。别玩儿了！快看书！快看书！”
sentences.traditional: “這本書就不錯，那本也很好。別玩兒了！快看書！快看書！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè běn shū jiù bú cuò nà běn yě hěn hǎo bié wán'r le kuài kàn shū kuài kàn shū
sentences.english: .. “This book is not bad, and that one is also very good. Stop playing! Read some books! Read some books!”

sentences.simplified: 周明一想到看书就有点头疼，但还是答应了温姬。
sentences.traditional: 周明一想到看書就有點頭疼，但還是答應了溫姬。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng yì xiǎng dào kàn shū jiù yǒu diǎn tóu téng dàn hái shi dā ying le wēn jī
sentences.english: Zhou Ming got a headache as soon as he thought of reading, but he agreed with Wen Ji.

sentence_translations: Dirty Shoes
That day, it rained heavily again. Zhou Ming was reading at home, but his heart was no longer in the book.
By evening, the rain curtain outside the window was even denser.
Zhou Ming looked out expectantly for a while, then shook his head and gently breathed out.
He thought, “Wen Ji won’t come in such heavy rain.”
Zhou Ming decided to go to bed. At this moment, he heard a familiar sound.
Someone was knocking on the door, calling his name.
It was Wen Ji!
Hearing this sound, Zhou Ming’s heart jumped quickly again.
He quickly stood up and opened the door, and the figure of Wen Ji appeared.
The beautiful Wen Ji, the lovely Wen Ji, had now become the dirty Wen Ji.
Her hair was dripping with water, the silver ornament on her head was much darker, and her clothes were all wet.
But this didn’t affect Wen Ji’s good mood.
She just unfastened her belt, then took off her wet clothes and tossed them aside.
Then she took off her wet shoes, happily gave Zhou Ming a hug, and laughed loudly.
Zhou Ming touched her wet hair. His heart was filled with joy and affection.
Wen Ji kissed Zhou Ming and said, “I’m so cold. I’m going to bed now.” Then she withdrew into the quilt.
Zhou Ming couldn’t see her gaze and could only hear her smiling voice, ..
.. “Ah, my shoes are all wet. Please wipe them for me.”
Zhou Ming looked at the shoes Wen Ji had taken off.
It was a pair of gorgeous and colorful cloth shoes, with yellow butterflies, red flowers, and white clouds on them.
They were very beautiful, but now they were all soiled by mud and dripping with water.
Zhou Ming had never done anything like cleaning shoes before.
However, without saying a word, he carefully found a piece of cloth and dampened it, ..
.. bent over, and started to gently wipe the mud from the shoes.
Most of the mud was wiped off by the cloth, but the shoes also became dirty and didn’t look as good as they used to.
The butterflies on the shoes were hidden in the mud and couldn’t be seen clearly.
They were not so much dirty as they were completely ruined. Zhou Ming felt that this was a pity.
Wen Ji pulled back the quilt, showing half of her head mischievously.
Seeing Zhou Ming’s look of regret, she said, “Thank you, sir, for helping me clean my shoes.”
She smiled, her eyes full of affection, “I didn’t deliberately make sir do dirty and tiring things for me …
But, I hope you see these muddy shoes and understand my sincerity in coming in the rain.”
The rain outside the window was still falling, a cold wind was blowing, and cold rain dripping.
It was cold, but the passion of the two people was no less.
Under the quilt, Wen Ji was in the arms of her handsome lover, ..
.. listening to his heartbeat with her left ear and the fine rain with her right ear.
She softly said one line of a poem. Then she kissed Zhou Ming and had him think about how to continue with another line.
But Zhou Ming blushed and just said, “Well … I don’t understand poetry. Let’s forget about it.”
Wen Ji glanced at him quickly and said with a strange expression, ..
.. “How could a handsome scholar like you not understand poetry? Really … my good mood is gone.”
Wen Ji raised her eyebrows, her face showing dissatisfaction.
“You can’t go on like this, only knowing how to play around!”
Wen Ji reminded Zhou Ming, “None of us girls can go to school. We can only learn to cook and make clothes at home.
You are a man who has the opportunity to go to school. You mustn’t be lazy!
Instead of wasting time, spend some of the time you think about me reading books instead.“
Wen Ji turned over in the quilt, looked at Zhou Ming earnestly, and kept on reminiscing, ..
.. “This book is not bad, and that one is also very good. Stop playing! Read some books! Read some books!”
Zhou Ming got a headache as soon as he thought of reading, but he agreed with Wen Ji.
